extension.description: A dark, cinematic Kodi skin with glass panels, large backdrops and rows for Trakt continue watching, trending titles, your library and your liked Trakt lists (via Seren).
Een donkere, cinematische Kodi-skin met glazen panelen, grote achtergronden en rijen voor Trakt verder kijken, trending titels, je bibliotheek en je Trakt-lijsten (via Seren).
extension.news: 1.9.4: Calendar opens a series straight on its seasons in Seren (no search), week view spacing. 1.9.3: list view: the duration no longer disappears behind the watched check mark. 1.9.2: the Calendar now shows the series and films of your Trakt collection; the bell (off by default) gives a pop-up for a new episode or a digital film release. 1.9.1: nicer on-screen keyboard, Enter on a real keyboard now finishes typing, the Settings home screen wraps around. 1.9.0: new Calendar tab (Week, List, Month) for the series and films you follow with the bell on the info page, with a pop-up when a new episode is out (Watch now / Later; switch in Skin settings > Tracking). 1.8.5: Home rows and skin settings wrap around too. 1.8.4: Back stops the video, lists wrap around, Right goes to OK in add-on settings, trailers stop when you move on. 1.8.3: trailer video no longer hidden behind the Home background on CoreELEC. 1.8.2: trailers close the YouTube error pop-up and pause after repeated failures. 1.8.1: sidebar now says Lucent. 1.8.0: Lucent is now its own add-on (skin.lucent). On first start it takes over all settings, menu and widgets of Nuvio Arc.
